title: Wanting to be a general; Mr. Dorsey, the White Wing wagon and the draft
summary: At ten he wanted to be a general; he loved riding with Mr. William Dorsey on his street-cleaning wagon, saw omens of pigeons before Dorsey and another relative were drafted, and obeyed his mother absolutely.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I was about 10 years old, then I starting thinking

about seriously, I like music, but I always wanted to be one of those generals too, you know, oh, yes, I wanted to be -- they moved me, but then there was man, his name was -- my uncle was named Uncle William, he'd come up from New Orleans, then lived in a house called Mr. Dorsey, his family is Indian and he had everything in his family. He come from Annapolis, Maryland. Great contractors now, and Mr. Dorsey, --

That's right, and Mr. Dorsey liked me and I liked Mr. Dorsey, he was the one who worked on the wagon, called the White Wing, when the horses -- White Wing would get this stuff off the street because in Washington at that time the streets was clean, clean as could be and Mr. Dorsey would come and White Wings, they had white coats on and they looked something -- had something looked like our garbage can now and put this in his wagon and I'd be up there with Mr. Dorsey and that stuff was smelling and it smelt like perfume to me, I was so happy. I was the happiest man up there with Mr. Dorsey.

So now here is my first sadness. He come up in the draft and he had to leave, see, and I had another uncle, he married my aunt, he had to leave, but Mr. Dorsey had to leave but before Mr. Dorsey got his draft notice, I was sleeping -- I don't know if I was sleeping or not, three pigeons come in

the window, I saw, I think I saw and I woke right up and I was -- and I said Mama, three pigeons and she says, yes, I know, son and then the next day there was Mr. Dorsey, there was my foster, not my foster -- but by marriage, he had to go and then there was another person that had to go, so Mama said, (unintelligible) she didn't put too much to it, but she knew, but I didn't know. I didn't know about that.

So, all right, everybody come back and by that time Mama was telling me something else, and I'm looking around talking halfway bassing, see, I done grow too big for Mama so when Mama really wants something happen, Mama would grab me by the arm and drop that tooth on me and bite me so badly, yes, Mama, anything, she'd be chewing on me. Mama was a very small woman, she had very small feet and small -- and whatever Mama wanted done, I did that, and did it quickly, and nothing was no problem.
